import hashlib
import hmac
import os
import time
import json
from http.server import HTTPServer, BaseHTTPRequestHandler
from urllib.parse import urlparse, parse_qs
import threading
import sqlite3

SECRET_KEY = os.urandom(32)
SESSION_STORE = {}
AUDIT_DB = "audit.db"

def init_db():
    conn = sqlite3.connect(AUDIT_DB)
    c = conn.cursor()
    c.execute('''CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS audit_log
                 (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, timestamp REAL, user TEXT,
                  action TEXT, target TEXT, token_hash TEXT)''')
    conn.commit()
    conn.close()

def generate_csrf_token(session_id):
    timestamp = str(int(time.time()))
    payload = f"{session_id}:{timestamp}"
    signature = hmac.new(SECRET_KEY, payload.encode(), hashlib.sha256).hexdigest()
    return f"{payload}:{signature}"

def validate_csrf_token(session_id, token):
    if not token:
        return False
    parts = token.split(":")
    if len(parts) != 3:
        return False
    token_session, timestamp, signature = parts
    if token_session != session_id:
        return False
    try:
        token_age = int(time.time()) - int(timestamp)
    except (ValueError, TypeError):
        return False
    if token_age > 3600:
        return False
    expected_payload = f"{token_session}:{timestamp}"
    expected_sig = hmac.new(SECRET_KEY, expected_payload.encode(), hashlib.sha256).hexdigest()
    return hmac.compare_digest(signature, expected_sig)

def log_audit_event(user, action, target, token):
    token_hash = hashlib.sha256(token.encode()).hexdigest() if token else "none"
    conn = sqlite3.connect(AUDIT_DB)
    c = conn.cursor()
    c.execute("INSERT INTO audit_log (timestamp, user, action, target, token_hash) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?)",
             (time.time(), user, action, target, token_hash))
    conn.commit()
    conn.close()

class ProxyRequestHandler(BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
    def get_session(self):
        cookie_header = self.headers.get("Cookie", "")
        for cookie in cookie_header.split(";"):
            cookie = cookie.strip()
            if cookie.startswith("session_id="):
                sid = cookie[len("session_id="):]
                if sid in SESSION_STORE:
                    return sid, SESSION_STORE[sid]
        return None, None

    def authenticate(self):
        session_id, session_data = self.get_session()
        if not session_data:
            self.send_response(401)
            self.end_headers()
            self.wfile.write(b"Unauthorized")
            return None, None
        return session_id, session_data

    def do_GET(self):
        session_id, session_data = self.authenticate()
        if not session_data:
            return
        parsed = urlparse(self.path)
        if parsed.path == "/api/proxy/status":
            self.send_response(200)
            self.send_header("Content-Type", "application/json")
            self.end_headers()
            token = generate_csrf_token(session_id)
            response = {"status": "active", "user": session_data["user"], "csrf_token": token}
            self.wfile.write(json.dumps(response).encode())
        elif parsed.path == "/api/audit/log":
            conn = sqlite3.connect(AUDIT_DB)
            c = conn.cursor()
            c.execute("SELECT * FROM audit_log WHERE user = ? ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 50",
                     (session_data["user"],))
            rows = c.fetchall()
            conn.close()
            self.send_response(200)
            self.send_header("Content-Type", "application/json")
            self.end_headers()
            self.wfile.write(json.dumps(rows).encode())

    def do_POST(self):
        session_id, session_data = self.authenticate()
        if not session_data:
            return
        content_length = int(self.headers.get("Content-Length", 0))
        body = self.rfile.read(content_length).decode()
        parsed = urlparse(self.path)

        if parsed.path == "/api/proxy/configure":
            try:
                data = json.loads(body)
            except json.JSONDecodeError:
                self.send_response(400)
                self.end_headers()
                return

            csrf_token = data.get("csrf_token", "")
            action = data.get("action", "")
            target = data.get("target", "")

            # Validate CSRF token and log the attempt
            token_valid = validate_csrf_token(session_id, csrf_token)
            log_audit_event(session_data["user"], action, target, csrf_token)

            if not token_valid:
                self.send_response(403)
                self.send_header("Content-Type", "application/json")
                self.end_headers()
                self.wfile.write(json.dumps({"error": "CSRF validation failed"}).encode())
                return

            # Process the proxy configuration
            result = self._apply_proxy_config(action, target, session_data)
            self.send_response(200)
            self.send_header("Content-Type", "application/json")
            self.end_headers()
            self.wfile.write(json.dumps(result).encode())

        elif parsed.path == "/api/proxy/route":
            try:
                data = json.loads(body)
            except json.JSONDecodeError:
                self.send_response(400)
                self.end_headers()
                return

            # Route management uses referrer-based validation for backward compat
            origin = self.headers.get("Origin", "")
            referer = self.headers.get("Referer", "")
            csrf_token = self.headers.get("X-CSRF-Token", data.get("csrf_token", ""))

            is_same_origin = self._check_origin(origin, referer)
            token_valid = validate_csrf_token(session_id, csrf_token)

            # Defense in depth: require BOTH valid origin AND valid token
            if is_same_origin and token_valid:
                action = data.get("action", "")
                target = data.get("target", "")
                log_audit_event(session_data["user"], action, target, csrf_token)
                result = self._apply_route_config(action, target, session_data)
                self.send_response(200)
                self.send_header("Content-Type", "application/json")
                self.end_headers()
                self.wfile.write(json.dumps(result).encode())
            else:
                self.send_response(403)
                self.end_headers()
                self.wfile.write(b"CSRF check failed")

    def _check_origin(self, origin, referer):
        allowed_origins = ["https://proxy.internal.corp", "https://admin.internal.corp"]
        if origin and origin in allowed_origins:
            return True
        if referer:
            parsed_ref = urlparse(referer)
            ref_origin = f"{parsed_ref.scheme}://{parsed_ref.netloc}"
            return ref_origin in allowed_origins
        return False

    def _apply_proxy_config(self, action, target, session_data):
        return {"applied": True, "action": action, "target": target}

    def _apply_route_config(self, action, target, session_data):
        return {"routed": True, "action": action, "target": target}

def create_session(username):
    session_id = hashlib.sha256(os.urandom(32)).hexdigest()
    SESSION_STORE[session_id] = {"user": username, "created": time.time()}
    return session_id

if __name__ == "__main__":
    init_db()
    server = HTTPServer(("0.0.0.0", 8080), ProxyRequestHandler)
    print("Proxy server running on :8080")
    server.serve_forever()
